parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas — warm off-white slightly creamier than pure white, gives the whole site its book-page atmosphere

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, section backgrounds, footer — the slightly cooler clean white used for elevated content areas

linen.$description: Linen — Input fields, subtle surface wash, nav fill — barely-perceptible off-white that reads as neutral

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary foreground token, strong body text where maximum contrast is needed

graphite.$description: Graphite — Headlines and key body text — softer than pure black, pairs with the warm canvas

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text, button text — the workhorse text tone for body copy and UI labels

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, descriptive copy, subdued UI

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary borders, disabled states, lightest neutral in the scale

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders on cards, buttons, and section dividers — green-tinted to harmonize with illustrations

twilight.$description: Twilight — Near-black with a cool blue undertone — used for nav borders, icon strokes, and outlined actions; reads darker than its lightness suggests

dusk.$description: Dusk — Filled button background — a near-black with cool violet undertone, the only non-white filled surface in the system

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cerulean.$description: Cerulean — Vivid blue used for a singular saturated card surface — the lone moment of pure color intensity, used sparingly as atmospheric punctuation

ppmondwest.$description: Custom display serif for headlines and editorial copy — the voice of the brand. Tight -0.04em tracking at large sizes makes it feel set rather than typed; weight 400 even at 54px creates a confident, literary register rather than the 700-weight shouts common in tech. Liga features disabled.

af.$description: Custom sans for all UI, body copy, navigation, buttons, and small headings — a quiet, neutral workhorse. Weight 500 is the default for interactive and label text; weight 400 for body. Slight negative tracking (-0.01em) keeps dense UI from feeling airy.
